name: io.github.koller-nexus/vps-ops-mcp
title: VPS Ops
description: Stdio MCP server that inspects and (with confirmation) mutates one VPS over SSH.

environmentVariables.name: VPS_SSH_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a readable SSH private key

environmentVariables.name: VPS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH hostname of the single target VPS

environmentVariables.name: VPS_COMPOSE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute Compose directory on the remote host

environmentVariables.name: VPS_LOG_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Stdout/stderr byte cap for remote commands

environmentVariables.name: VPS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set false to reject every mutation tool

environmentVariables.name: VPS_SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional key passphrase; prefer ssh-agent instead
